export function parseMinute(s) {
58—
  if (s === null || s === undefined) return 0;
59—
  const str = String(s);
60—
  const [a, b] = str.split("+");
61—
  const base = parseInt(a, 10) || 0;
62—
  const extra = b !== undefined ? (parseInt(b, 10) || 0) : 0;
63—
  return base + extra;
64—
}
65—
66—
// "80,824" -> 80824；非法返回 null
67—
export function parseAttendance(s) {
68—
  if (s === null || s === undefined) return null;
69—
  const n = parseInt(String(s).replace(/,/g, ""), 10);
70—
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
71—
}

export function resolveTeam(input) {
136—
  if (!input) return { ok: false, error: "empty team input", suggestions: [] };
137—
  const q = String(input).trim().toLowerCase();
138—
  if (!q) return { ok: false, error: "empty team input", suggestions: [] };
139—
140—
  // 1) 精确匹配代码
141—
  const codeHit = Object.keys(TEAMS).find((c) => c.toLowerCase() === q);
142—
  if (codeHit) return { ok: true, code: codeHit };
143—
144—
  // 2) 精确匹配英文名 / 中文名
145—
  for (const code of Object.keys(TEAMS)) {
146—
    const t = TEAMS[code];
147—
    const en = (t.name && t.name.en || "").toLowerCase();
148—
    const zh = (t.name && t.name.zh || "").toLowerCase();
149—
    if (en === q || zh === q) return { ok: true, code };
150—
  }
151—
152—
  // 3) 子串匹配，收集建议
153—
  const suggestions = [];
154—
  for (const code of Object.keys(TEAMS)) {
155—
    const t = TEAMS[code];
156—
    const en = (t.name && t.name.en || "").toLowerCase();
157—
    const zh = (t.name && t.name.zh || "").toLowerCase();
158—
    if (en.includes(q) || zh.includes(q)) {
159—
      suggestions.push({ code, en: t.name.en, zh: t.name.zh });
160—
      if (suggestions.length >= 5) break;
161—
    }
162—
  }
163—
  return { ok: false, error: `unknown team: ${input}`, suggestions };
164—
}
165—
166—
// ============ 球员解析 ============

// 预构建：小写英文名 -> {name, zh, team}（team 取最后出现场次）
168—
const playerIndex = new Map();
169—
function buildPlayerIndex() {
170—
  for (const m of MATCHES) {
171—
    for (const g of m.goals || []) {
172—
      if (!g.player) continue;
173—
      const key = g.player.toLowerCase();
174—
      playerIndex.set(key, { name: g.player, zh: PNAMES[g.player] || null, team: g.team });
175—
    }
176—
    for (const c of m.cards || []) {
177—
      if (!c.player) continue;
178—
      const key = c.player.toLowerCase();
179—
      if (!playerIndex.has(key)) {
180—
        playerIndex.set(key, { name: c.player, zh: PNAMES[c.player] || null, team: c.team });
181—
      }
182—
    }
183—
  }
184—
}
185—
buildPlayerIndex();

export function playerZhOf(name) {
188—

189—
  return PNAMES[name] || null;
190—
}

// 输入英文或中文名，返回 { ok:true, players:[{name, zh, team}] } 或 { ok:false, suggestions }
193—
export function resolvePlayer(input) {
194—
  if (!input) return { ok: false, error: "empty player input", suggestions: [] };
195—
  const q = String(input).trim().toLowerCase();
196—
  if (!q) return { ok: false, error: "empty player input", suggestions: [] };
197—
198—
  // 精确命中（英文名）
199—
  if (playerIndex.has(q)) {
200—
    const p = playerIndex.get(q);
201—
    return { ok: true, players: [{ name: p.name, zh: p.zh, team: p.team }] };
202—
  }
203—
204—
  // 中文名反查
205—
  const zhHits = [];
206—
  for (const [en, zh] of Object.entries(PNAMES)) {
207—
    if (zh === input.trim()) { zhHits.push(en); }
208—
  }
209—
  if (zhHits.length === 1) {
210—
    const en = zhHits[0];
211—
    const p = playerIndex.get(en.toLowerCase()) || { name: en, zh: input.trim(), team: null };
212—
    return { ok: true, players: [{ name: p.name, zh: p.zh || input.trim(), team: p.team }] };
213—
  }
214—
215—
  // 子串匹配（英文）
216—
  const hits = [];
217—
  for (const [key, p] of playerIndex) {
218—
    if (key.includes(q) || (p.zh && p.zh.includes(input.trim()))) {
219—
      hits.push({ name: p.name, zh: p.zh, team: p.team });
220—
      if (hits.length >= 5) break;
221—
    }
222—
  }
223—
  if (hits.length === 1) return { ok: true, players: hits };
224—
  if (hits.length > 1) {
225—
    return { ok: false, error: `ambiguous player: ${input}`, suggestions: hits.map((h) => h.name) };
226—
  }
227—
  return { ok: false, error: `unknown player: ${input}`, suggestions: [] };
228—
}

export const BY_ROUND = new Map();  // round -> matches[]

(function buildIndexes() {

239—

247—

249—

250—
      BY_TEAM.get(code).push(m);
251—
    }

  }

})();

29—

30—

32—

Answer ONLY in ${zh ? "Simplified Chinese (简体中文)" : "English"}, regardless of the language the user typed in.

${zh

    const ms = MATCHES.filter((m) =>
57—
      (m.home.code === a.code && m.away.code === b.code) || (m.home.code === b.code && m.away.code === a.code));
58—
    if (ms.length === 0) return fail(`no match between ${args.team_a} and ${args.team_b}`);
59—
    const m = args.date ? ms.find((x) => x.date === args.date) || ms[0] : ms[0];
60—
    return wrap({
61—
      ...matchBrief(m),
62—
      time: m.time, referee: m.referee, attendance: m.attendance,
63—
      goals: (m.goals || []).map((g) => ({ ...g, minuteNum: parseMinute(g.minute) })),
64—
      cards: (m.cards || []).map((c) => ({ ...c, minuteNum: parseMinute(c.minute), isStaff: isStaff(c.player) })),
65—
    });
66—
  }
67—
  return fail("need match_id, or team_a+team_b", { hint: 'e.g. {"match_id":104}' });
68—
}
69—
70—
// 2. list_matches —— 筛选列表（精简投影）
71—
function tListMatches(args) {
72—
  let out = MATCHES.slice();
73—
  if (args.team) {
74—
    const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
75—
    if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
76—
    out = out.filter((m) => m.home.code === r.code || m.away.code === r.code);
77—
  }
78—
  if (args.group) out = out.filter((m) => m.group === args.group);
79—
  if (args.stage) out = out.filter((m) => m.stage === args.stage);
80—
  if (args.round) {
81—
    const r = normalizeRound(args.round);
82—
    if (!r) return fail(`unknown round ${args.round}`, { hint: ROUNDS.join(", ") });
83—
    out = out.filter((m) => m.round === r);
84—
  }
85—
  if (args.date_from) out = out.filter((m) => m.date >= args.date_from);
86—
  if (args.date_to) out = out.filter((m) => m.date <= args.date_to);
87—
  out.sort((x, y) => x.id - y.id);
88—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 20), 104);
89—
  const truncated = out.length > limit;
90—
  return ok({ count: out.length, returned: truncated ? limit : out.length, truncated, matches: out.slice(0, limit).map(matchBrief) });
91—
}
92—
93—
// 3. get_standings —— 积分榜
94—
function tGetStandings(args) {
95—
  if (args.group) {
96—
    const rows = STANDINGS[args.group];
97—
    if (!rows) return fail(`group ${args.group} not found`, { hint: "A-L" });
98—
    return ok({ group: args.group, standings: rows });
99—
  }
100—
  return ok({ groups: Object.keys(STANDINGS).map((g) => ({ group: g, standings: STANDINGS[g] })) });
101—
}
102—
103—
// 4. get_bracket —— 淘汰赛对阵
104—
function tGetBracket(args) {
105—
  const order = ["round_of_32", "round_of_16", "quarterfinal", "semifinal", "third_place", "final"];
106—
  const bracketKey = { round_of_32: "round_of_32", round_of_16: "round_of_16", quarterfinal: "quarterfinals", semifinal: "semifinals", third_place: "third_place", final: "final" };
107—
  const project = (n) => ({
108—
    id: n.id, home: n.home, away: n.away, homeName: n.homeName, awayName: n.awayName,
109—
    score: n.score, homeScore: n.homeScore, awayScore: n.awayScore,
110—
    date: n.date, stadium: n.stadium, winner: n.winner,
111—
  });
112—
  if (args.round) {
113—
    const r = normalizeRound(args.round);
114—
    if (!r) return fail(`unknown round ${args.round}`, { hint: "r32,r16,qf,sf,third_place,final" });
115—
    const v = BRACKET[bracketKey[r]];
116—
    if (!v) return fail(`bracket round ${r} not found`);
117—
    const arr = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
118—
    return ok({ round: r, matches: arr.map(project) });
119—
  }
120—
  const all = [];
121—
  for (const r of order) {
122—
    const v = BRACKET[bracketKey[r]];
123—
    const arr = Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v ? [v] : []);
124—
    all.push({ round: r, matches: arr.map(project) });
125—
  }
126—
  return ok({ bracket: all });
127—
}

// 5. get_awards —— 奖项
130—
function tGetAwards() {
131—
  const pick = (o) => o ? { code: o.code, name: o.name, title: o.title } : null;

  return ok({
133—
    champion: pick(AWARDS.champion), runner_up: pick(AWARDS.runner_up),
134—
    third_place: pick(AWARDS.third_place), fourth_place: pick(AWARDS.fourth_place),
135—
    golden_ball: AWARDS.golden_ball, golden_boot: AWARDS.golden_boot,
136—
    golden_glove: AWARDS.golden_glove, young_player: AWARDS.young_player,
137—
    fair_play: AWARDS.fair_play, tournament_stats: AWARDS.tournament_stats,
138—
  });
139—
}

// 6. get_team_info —— 球队档案
142—
function tGetTeamInfo(args) {
143—
  const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
144—

// 7. get_venue_info —— 球场信息
158—
function tGetVenueInfo(args) {
159—
  if (args.name) {
160—
    const q = String(args.name).trim().toLowerCase();
161—
    const hit = Object.entries(VENUES).find(([slug, v]) =>
162—
      slug.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (v.name.en || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || (v.name.zh || "").includes(q) ||
163—
      (v.city.en || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || (v.city.zh || "").includes(q));

    if (!hit) return fail(`venue ${args.name} not found`);

    const [slug, v] = hit;

    return ok({ slug, name: v.name, city: v.city, country: v.country, capacity: v.capacity });

169—
}

171—
// ============ B. 射手/助攻 (2) ============
172—
173—
// 8. get_top_scorers —— 射手榜（排除乌龙）
174—
function tGetTopScorers(args) {
175—
  const tally = new Map();
176—
  const byTeam = new Map();
177—
  for (const m of MATCHES) {
178—
    for (const g of m.goals || []) {
179—
      if (g.isOwnGoal || !g.player) continue;
180—
      if (!tally.has(g.player)) tally.set(g.player, { player: g.player, playerZh: playerZhOf(g.player) || g.player, team: g.team, goals: 0, penalties: 0, openPlay: 0 });
181—
      const e = tally.get(g.player);
182—
      e.goals++; if (g.isPenalty) e.penalties++; else e.openPlay++;
183—
      if (!byTeam.has(g.player)) byTeam.set(g.player, g.team);
184—
    }
185—
  }
186—
  let list = [...tally.values()].sort((a, b) => (b.goals - a.goals) || (a.penalties - b.penalties));
187—
  if (args.team) {
188—
    const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
189—
    if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
190—
    list = list.filter((e) => byTeam.get(e.player) === r.code);
191—
  }
192—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 50);
193—
  return ok({ count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
194—
}
195—
196—
// 9. get_top_assists —— 助攻榜（仅官方 top10）
197—
function tGetTopAssists(args) {
198—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 10);
199—
  return ok({ note: "only the official top 10 assists are available in this dataset", top: (AWARDS.top_assists || []).slice(0, limit) });
200—
}
201—
202—
// ============ C. 进球与结果统计 (4) ============
203—
204—
// 10. tournament_goal_stats —— 进球统计
205—
function tTournamentGoalStats(args) {
206—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
207—
  if (pool.length === 0) return fail("no matches for this scope");
208—
  let totalGoals = 0, penalties = 0, ownGoals = 0, cleanSheets = 0, draws = 0;
209—
  let biggest = { margin: -1 };
210—
  const goalsByPeriod = { "1-15": 0, "16-30": 0, "31-45": 0, "46-60": 0, "61-75": 0, "76-90": 0, "90+": 0 };
211—
  for (const m of pool) {
212—
    totalGoals += m.homeScore + m.awayScore;
213—
    if (m.homeScore === 0 || m.awayScore === 0) cleanSheets++;
214—
    if (m.homeScore === m.awayScore) draws++;
215—
    const margin = Math.abs(m.homeScore - m.awayScore);
216—
    if (margin > biggest.margin) biggest = { margin, match: matchBrief(m) };
217—
    for (const g of m.goals || []) {
218—
      if (g.isPenalty) penalties++;
219—
      if (g.isOwnGoal) ownGoals++;
220—
      const t = parseMinute(g.minute);
221—
      if (t <= 15) goalsByPeriod["1-15"]++;
222—
      else if (t <= 30) goalsByPeriod["16-30"]++;
223—
      else if (t <= 45) goalsByPeriod["31-45"]++;
224—
      else if (t <= 60) goalsByPeriod["46-60"]++;
225—
      else if (t <= 75) goalsByPeriod["61-75"]++;
226—
      else if (t <= 90) goalsByPeriod["76-90"]++;
227—
      else goalsByPeriod["90+"]++;
228—
    }
229—
  }
230—
  const avg = Math.round((totalGoals / pool.length) * 100) / 100;
231—
  return ok({
232—
    scope: { stage: args.scope || "all", group: args.group || null, round: args.round ? normalizeRound(args.round) : null },
233—
    matches: pool.length, totalGoals, avgGoals: avg, penalties, ownGoals,
234—
    cleanSheets, draws, biggestMargin: biggest,
235—
    goalsByPeriod,
236—
    note: "own goals count in the scoreline but are excluded from player tallies",
237—
  });
238—
}
239—
240—
// 11. biggest_wins —— 最大分差
241—
function tBiggestWins(args) {
242—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
243—
  const list = pool
244—
    .filter((m) => m.homeScore !== m.awayScore)
245—
    .map((m) => ({ ...matchBrief(m), margin: Math.abs(m.homeScore - m.awayScore) }))
246—
    .sort((a, b) => (b.margin - a.margin) || ((b.homeScore + b.awayScore) - (a.homeScore + a.awayScore)));
247—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 5), 20);
248—
  return ok({ count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
249—
}
250—
251—
// 12. highest_scoring_matches —— 总进球最多
252—
function tHighestScoringMatches(args) {
253—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
254—
  const list = pool
255—
    .map((m) => ({ ...matchBrief(m), totalGoals: m.homeScore + m.awayScore }))
256—
    .sort((a, b) => (b.totalGoals - a.totalGoals) || (b.id - a.id));
257—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 5), 20);
258—
  return ok({ count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
259—
}
260—
261—
// 13. compare_scorers —— 球员对比（2-5 人）
262—
function tCompareScorers(args) {
263—
  const players = (args.players || []).slice(0, 5);
264—
  if (players.length < 2) return fail("compare at least 2 players", { hint: '{"players":["Mbappé","Messi"]}' });
265—
  const out = [];
266—
  const seen = new Set();
267—
  for (const raw of players) {
268—
    const r = resolvePlayer(raw);
269—
    if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
270—
    const p = r.players[0];
271—
    if (seen.has(p.name)) continue;
272—
    seen.add(p.name);
273—
    const games = [];
274—
    for (const m of MATCHES) {
275—
      for (const g of m.goals || []) {
276—
        if (g.isOwnGoal) continue;
277—
        if (g.player.toLowerCase() === p.name.toLowerCase()) {
278—
          games.push({ matchId: m.id, date: m.date, opponent: g.team === m.home.code ? m.away.code : m.home.code, minute: g.minute, minuteNum: parseMinute(g.minute), isPenalty: g.isPenalty });
279—
        }
280—
      }
281—
    }
282—
    games.sort((a, b) => a.minuteNum - b.minuteNum);
283—
    const goals = games.length;
284—
    const penalties = games.filter((g) => g.isPenalty).length;
285—
    out.push({
286—
      player: p.name, playerZh: p.zh || p.name, team: p.team, goals, penalties, openPlay: goals - penalties,
287—
      matchIds: games.map((g) => g.matchId), minutes: games.map((g) => g.minute),
288—
      firstGoalDate: games.length ? games[0].date : null,
289—
    });
290—
  }
291—
  out.sort((a, b) => b.goals - a.goals || a.penalties - b.penalties);
292—
  return ok({ compared: out });
293—
}
294—
295—
// ============ D. 红黄牌纪律 (3) ============
296—
297—
// 14. card_rankings_by_player —— 球员牌榜
298—
function tCardRankingsByPlayer(args) {
299—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
300—
  const tally = new Map();
301—
  for (const m of pool) {
302—
    for (const c of m.cards || []) {
303—
      if (!c.player) continue;
304—
      if (!tally.has(c.player)) tally.set(c.player, { player: c.player, playerZh: playerZhOf(c.player) || c.player, team: c.team, yellow: 0, red: 0, total: 0, isStaff: isStaff(c.player), matchIds: [] });
305—
      const e = tally.get(c.player);
306—
      if (c.type === "red") e.red++; else e.yellow++;
307—
      e.total++;
308—
      if (!e.matchIds.includes(m.id)) e.matchIds.push(m.id);
309—
    }
310—
  }
311—
  let list = [...tally.values()];
312—
  if (args.team) {
313—
    const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
314—
    if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
315—
    list = list.filter((e) => e.team === r.code);
316—
  }
317—
  if (args.type === "yellow") list = list.filter((e) => e.yellow > 0).sort((a, b) => b.yellow - a.yellow || b.red - a.red);
318—
  else if (args.type === "red") list = list.filter((e) => e.red > 0).sort((a, b) => b.red - a.red || b.yellow - a.yellow);
319—
  else list.sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total || b.red - a.red);
320—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 50);
321—
  return ok({ note: "only yellow and red card types exist; entries flagged isStaff are coaching staff", count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
322—
}
323—
324—
// 15. card_rankings_by_team —— 球队牌榜
325—
function tCardRankingsByTeam(args) {
326—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
327—
  const tally = new Map();
328—
  for (const m of pool) {
329—
    for (const c of m.cards || []) {
330—
      if (!c.team) continue;
331—
      if (!tally.has(c.team)) tally.set(c.team, { team: c.team, yellow: 0, red: 0, total: 0, matches: 0 });
332—
      const e = tally.get(c.team);
333—
      if (c.type === "red") e.red++; else e.yellow++;
334—
      e.total++;
335—
    }
336—
  }
337—
  // 出场次数统一用 BY_TEAM（全赛事出场）
338—
  const rows = [...tally.values()].map((e) => {
339—
    const played = (BY_TEAM.get(e.team) || []).length;
340—
    return { ...e, matches: played, cardsPerMatch: played ? Math.round((e.total / played) * 100) / 100 : 0 };
341—
  });
342—
  if (args.type === "yellow") rows.sort((a, b) => b.yellow - a.yellow || b.red - a.red);
343—
  else if (args.type === "red") rows.sort((a, b) => b.red - a.red || b.yellow - a.yellow);
344—
  else rows.sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total || b.red - a.red);
345—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 48);
346—
  return ok({ count: rows.length, top: rows.slice(0, limit) });
347—
}
348—
349—
// 16. cards_in_match —— 单场牌
350—
function tCardsInMatch(args) {
351—
  let m = null;
352—
  if (args.match_id) m = BY_ID.get(Number(args.match_id));
353—
  else if (args.team_a && args.team_b) {
354—
    const a = resolveTeam(args.team_a); const b = resolveTeam(args.team_b);
355—
    if (!a.ok) return fail(a.error, a.suggestions);
356—
    if (!b.ok) return fail(b.error, b.suggestions);
357—
    m = MATCHES.find((x) =>
358—
      (x.home.code === a.code && x.away.code === b.code) || (x.home.code === b.code && x.away.code === a.code)) || null;
359—
  }
360—
  if (!m) return fail("match not found", { hint: 'e.g. {"match_id":75}' });
361—
  const cards = (m.cards || []).map((c) => ({ ...c, minuteNum: parseMinute(c.minute), isStaff: isStaff(c.player) }))
362—
    .sort((a, b) => a.minuteNum - b.minuteNum || a.minute.localeCompare(b.minute, undefined, { numeric: true }));
363—
  return ok({ match: matchBrief(m), count: cards.length, cards });
364—
}
365—
366—
// ============ E. 交锋与战绩 (3) ============
367—
368—
function matchWinner(m) {
369—
  if (m.homeScore > m.awayScore) return m.home.code;
370—
  if (m.awayScore > m.homeScore) return m.away.code;
371—
  if (m.penaltyShootout) return m.penaltyShootout.home > m.penaltyShootout.away ? m.home.code : m.away.code;
372—
  return null; // draw
373—
}
374—
375—
// 17. head_to_head —— 两队交锋
376—
function tHeadToHead(args) {
377—
  const a = resolveTeam(args.team_a); const b = resolveTeam(args.team_b);
378—
  if (!a.ok) return fail(a.error, a.suggestions);
379—
  if (!b.ok) return fail(b.error, b.suggestions);
380—
  const meetings = MATCHES.filter((m) =>
381—
    (m.home.code === a.code && m.away.code === b.code) || (m.home.code === b.code && m.away.code === a.code));
382—
  const det = meetings.map((m) => {
383—
    const homeIsA = m.home.code === a.code;
384—
    const winner = matchWinner(m);
385—
    return {
386—
      id: m.id, date: m.date, round: m.round || "group", stage: m.stage,
387—
      home: m.home.code, away: m.away.code, score: m.score,
388—
      homeScore: m.homeScore, awayScore: m.awayScore,
389—
      winner, viaPenalties: !!m.penaltyShootout,
390—
      aWon: winner === a.code, bWon: winner === b.code, drawn: winner === null,
391—
    };
392—
  });
393—
  let aWins = 0, bWins = 0, draws = 0, aGoals = 0, bGoals = 0;
394—
  for (const d of det) {
395—
    if (d.aWon) aWins++; else if (d.bWon) bWins++; else draws++;
396—
    if (d.home === a.code) { aGoals += d.homeScore; bGoals += d.awayScore; }
397—
    else { aGoals += d.awayScore; bGoals += d.homeScore; }
398—
  }
399—
  return ok({
400—
    teamA: a.code, teamB: b.code,
401—
    played: det.length, aWins, draws, bWins, aGoals, bGoals,
402—
    meetings: det,
403—
    note: det.length === 0 ? "these two teams did not meet in this tournament" : "only this tournament's matches are included",
404—
  });
405—
}
406—
407—
// 18. team_knockout_record —— 淘汰赛之路
408—
function tTeamKnockoutRecord(args) {
409—
  const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
410—
  if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
411—
  const code = r.code;
412—
  const kos = MATCHES
413—
    .filter((m) => m.stage === "knockout" && (m.home.code === code || m.away.code === code))
414—
    .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
415—
  const roundOrder = { round_of_32: 1, round_of_16: 2, quarterfinal: 3, semifinal: 4, third_place: 5, final: 6 };
416—
  kos.sort((a, b) => (roundOrder[a.round] || 9) - (roundOrder[b.round] || 9));
417—
  const path = kos.map((m) => {
418—
    const opp = m.home.code === code ? m.away.code : m.home.code;
419—
    const winner = matchWinner(m);
420—
    return {
421—
      round: m.round, opponent: opp, score: m.score,
422—
      homeScore: m.homeScore, awayScore: m.awayScore,
423—
      result: winner === code ? "W" : (winner === null ? "D" : "L"),
424—
      viaPenalties: !!m.penaltyShootout, viaExtraTime: !!m.extraTime,
425—
    };
426—
  });
427—
  const w = path.filter((p) => p.result === "W").length;
428—
  const d = path.filter((p) => p.result === "D").length;
429—
  const l = path.filter((p) => p.result === "L").length;
430—
  const last = kos[kos.length - 1];
431—
  const reached = last ? (last.round === "final" && matchWinner(last) === code ? "champion" : last.round) : null;
432—
  const eliminatedBy = (last && matchWinner(last) !== code) ? (last.home.code === code ? last.away.code : last.home.code) : null;
433—
  return ok({ team: code, reached, eliminatedBy, played: kos.length, w, d, l, path });
434—
}
435—
436—
// 19. compare_groups —— 小组对比
437—
function tCompareGroups(args) {
438—
  let groups = args.groups && args.groups.length ? args.groups : Object.keys(GROUPS);
439—
  const out = [];
440—
  for (const g of groups) {
441—
    const pool = (BY_GROUP.get(g) || []).filter((m) => m.stage === "group");
442—
    let totalGoals = 0, yellow = 0, red = 0, draws = 0;
443—
    for (const m of pool) {
444—
      totalGoals += m.homeScore + m.awayScore;
445—
      if (m.homeScore === m.awayScore) draws++;
446—
      for (const c of m.cards || []) { if (c.type === "red") red++; else yellow++; }
447—
    }
448—
    const standing = STANDINGS[g] || [];
449—
    const topTeam = standing.length ? standing[0].code : null;
450—
    // 组内最佳射手
451—
    const tally = new Map();
452—
    for (const m of pool) {
453—
      for (const goal of m.goals || []) {
454—
        if (goal.isOwnGoal) continue;
455—
        if (!tally.has(goal.player)) tally.set(goal.player, { player: goal.player, playerZh: playerZhOf(goal.player) || goal.player, team: goal.team, goals: 0 });
456—
        tally.get(goal.player).goals++;
457—
      }
458—
    }
459—
    const topScorerInGroup = [...tally.values()].sort((a, b) => b.goals - a.goals)[0] || null;
460—
    out.push({
461—
      group: g, matches: pool.length, totalGoals,
462—
      avgGoals: pool.length ? Math.round((totalGoals / pool.length) * 100) / 100 : 0,
463—
      draws, yellow, red, topTeam, topScorerInGroup,
464—
    });
465—
  }
466—
  return ok({ groups: out });
467—
}
468—
469—
// 20. team_goal_ranking —— 球队进球/失球榜（全赛事或按阶段）
470—
function tTeamGoalRanking(args) {
471—
  const scope = args.scope; // all | group | knockout
472—
  const pool = scope === "group" ? MATCHES.filter((m) => m.stage === "group")
473—
            : scope === "knockout" ? MATCHES.filter((m) => m.stage === "knockout")
474—
            : MATCHES;
475—
  const gf = new Map(), ga = new Map(), played = new Map(), zh = new Map();
476—
  for (const m of pool) {
477—
    const h = m.home.code, a = m.away.code;
478—
    gf.set(h, (gf.get(h) || 0) + m.homeScore);
479—
    ga.set(h, (ga.get(h) || 0) + m.awayScore);
480—
    gf.set(a, (gf.get(a) || 0) + m.awayScore);
481—
    ga.set(a, (ga.get(a) || 0) + m.homeScore);
482—
    played.set(h, (played.get(h) || 0) + 1);
483—
    played.set(a, (played.get(a) || 0) + 1);
484—
    if (m.home.nameZh) zh.set(h, m.home.nameZh);
485—
    if (m.away.nameZh) zh.set(a, m.away.nameZh);
486—
  }
487—
  const rows = Object.keys(TEAMS).map((code) => {
488—
    const t = TEAMS[code];
489—
    const enName = (t.name && t.name.en) ? t.name.en : t.name;
490—
    const zhName = (t.name && t.name.zh) ? t.name.zh : (zh.get(code) || enName);
491—
    return {
492—
      code,
493—
      name: enName,
494—
      nameZh: zhName,
495—
      gf: gf.get(code) || 0,
496—
      ga: ga.get(code) || 0,
497—
      played: played.get(code) || 0,
498—
    };
499—
  });
500—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 48);
501—
  const byFor = rows.slice().sort((x, y) => (y.gf - x.gf) || (x.ga - y.ga) || x.code.localeCompare(y.code));
502—
  const byAgainst = rows.slice().sort((x, y) => (y.ga - x.ga) || (x.gf - y.gf) || x.code.localeCompare(y.code));
503—
  return ok({
504—
    scope: scope || "all",
505—
    topFor: byFor.slice(0, limit),
506—
    topAgainst: byAgainst.slice(0, limit),
507—
    mostFor: byFor[0] ? { code: byFor[0].code, name: byFor[0].name, nameZh: byFor[0].nameZh, gf: byFor[0].gf } : null,
508—
    mostAgainst: byAgainst[0] ? { code: byAgainst[0].code, name: byAgainst[0].name, nameZh: byAgainst[0].nameZh, ga: byAgainst[0].ga } : null,
509—
  });
510—
}

function readBody(req, maxBytes) {
25—
  const len = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") || 0);
26—
  if (len > maxBytes) return { tooLarge: true };
27—
  return { promise: req.text() };

}

function validateInput(body) {
31—
  if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return { error: "invalid body" };
32—
  const { messages, lang } = body;
33—
  if (!Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) return { error: "messages required" };
34—
  const clean = messages
35—
    .filter((m) => m && (m.role === "user" || m.role === "assistant"))
36—
    .slice(-8)
37—
    .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: String(m.content || "").slice(0, 600) }));
38—
  if (clean.length === 0) return { error: "no valid messages" };
39—
  const l = lang === "en" ? "en" : "zh";
40—
  return { messages: clean, lang: l };
41—
}

async function callDeepSeek({ messages, stream = false, tool_choice = "auto", signal }) {
45—
  const body = {
46—
    model: MODEL,

    messages,
48—
    tools: TOOL_SCHEMAS,

// 解析上游 SSE 块（处理网络分片）
69—
function parseSSEChunk(buf) {
70—
  const frames = [];
71—
  let start = 0;
72—
  while (true) {
73—
    const idx = buf.indexOf("\n\n", start);
74—
    if (idx === -1) break;
75—
    const frame = buf.slice(start, idx);
76—
    start = idx + 2;
77—
    const line = frame.split("\n").find((l) => l.startsWith("data:"));
78—
    if (!line || line.trim() === "data: [DONE]") {
79—
      if (line && line.trim() === "data: [DONE]") frames.push({ done: true });
80—
      continue;
81—
    }
82—
    try { frames.push(JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim())); }
83—
    catch { /* 坏行静默跳过 */ }
84—
  }
85—
  return { frames, rest: buf.slice(start) };
86—
}

function parseLegacyToolCalls(content) {

export default async (req, context) => {

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
134—

  }

142—

150—

  if (input.error) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: input.error }), { status: 400, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
152—
153—

154—
  if (!rl.durable) console.warn('[chat] durable rate limiting is not configured');
155—

164—

166—

167—

168—

    });

172—

176—

177—

178—

179—
      emit({ type: "ping" }); // 注释帧，强制刷新首字节
180—

181—
        const convo = [{ role: "system", content: buildSystemPrompt(lang) }, ...messages];
182—
        let answer = "";
183—

184—
185—
        // ---- 预处理：主动注入「进球/失球最多最少」排行数据 ----

202—

203—

211—
          if (!res.ok) {
212—

213—

214—
            if (res.status === 429) { emit({ type: "error", code: "upstream_rate" }); }
215—
            else { emit({ type: "error", code: "upstream" }); }
216—
            emit({ type: "done" });
217—
            return;
218—
          }
219—
          const data = await res.json();
220—
          const msg = data.choices && data.choices[0] && data.choices[0].message;
221—
          if (!msg) {
222—
            emit({ type: "error", code: "upstream" });
223—
            emit({ type: "done" });
224—

225—
          }
226—

230—

231—

232—
              function: { name: c.name, arguments: JSON.stringify(c.args) },
233—
            }));
234—
          }
235—
236—
          if (calls.length === 0) {
237—

238—

239—

241—

242—

243—
244—

245—
          convo.push({
246—
            role: "assistant",
247—
            content: msg.content || null,
248—
            tool_calls: calls.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, type: "function", function: { name: c.function.name, arguments: c.function.arguments } })),
249—
          });
250—
          for (const call of calls) {
251—
            let args = {};
252—
            try { args = JSON.parse(call.function.arguments || "{}"); } catch {}
253—
            emit({ type: "tool", name: call.function.name });
254—
            const out = runTool(call.function.name, args);
255—
            let content = JSON.stringify(out);
256—
            if (content.length > 6000) content = content.slice(0, 6000) + ',"_truncated":true';
257—
            convo.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, name: call.function.name, content });
258—
          }
259—
        }
260—
261—
        // ---- 循环用尽仍在要工具：强制收口 ----
262—
        finalStream = await callDeepSeek({ messages: convo, stream: true, tool_choice: "none", signal: controller.signal });
263—
        if (!finalStream.ok) {
264—
          console.error(`[chat] final upstream ${finalStream.status}`);
265—
          emit({ type: "error", code: "upstream" });
266—

269—

      Connection: "keep-alive",

      "X-Accel-Buffering": "no",

const DAY_SECONDS = 86_400;
2—
3—
function dayKey() {
4—
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
5—
}
6—
7—
async function command(command) {
8—
  const base = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL;
9—
  const token = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN;
10—
  if (!base || !token) return null;
11—
  const response = await fetch(`${base.replace(/\/$/, '')}/${command.map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')}`, {
12—
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
13—
  });
14—
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`rate store HTTP ${response.status}`);
15—
  const payload = await response.json();
16—
  return payload.result;
17—
}
18—
19—
async function increment(key, ttl) {
20—
  const count = await command(['incr', key]);
21—
  if (count === 1) await command(['expire', key, String(ttl)]);
22—
  return count;
23—
}
24—
25—
/**
26—
 * Uses Upstash Redis when configured. A missing/unavailable store intentionally
27—
 * fails open: availability of the public site is preserved and the caller logs
28—
 * a safe operational warning instead of retaining user content.
29—
 */
30—
export async function checkRateLimit(ip, { perIpCap, globalCap }) {
31—
  if (!process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL || !process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN) {
32—
    return { limited: false, durable: false };
33—
  }
34—
  const day = dayKey();
35—
  const safeIp = String(ip || 'unknown').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9:._-]/g, '_');
36—
  try {
37—
    const [ipCount, globalCount] = await Promise.all([
38—
      increment(`wc2026:chat:ip:${day}:${safeIp}`, DAY_SECONDS),
39—
      increment(`wc2026:chat:global:${day}`, DAY_SECONDS),
40—
    ]);
41—
    if (globalCount > globalCap) return { limited: true, retryAfter: 3600, durable: true };
42—
    if (ipCount > perIpCap) return { limited: true, retryAfter: 3600, durable: true };
43—
    return { limited: false, durable: true };
44—
  } catch (error) {
45—
    console.warn('[chat] rate store unavailable', { message: error?.message || 'unknown' });
46—
    return { limited: false, durable: false };
47—
  }
48—
}

// ---- 模式 1：Netlify Functions（服务器 Key） ----
219—
async function functionsReply(aiEl, status) {
220—
  controller = new AbortController();
221—
  let acc = '';
222—
  try {
223—
    const res = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
224—
      method: 'POST',
225—
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
226—
      body: JSON.stringify({ messages: history.slice(-8), lang: window.__lang || 'zh' }),
227—
      signal: controller.signal,
228—
    });
229—
    if (res.status === 429) throw new ChatError('rate');
230—
    if (res.status === 404) throw new ChatError('offline'); // 本地纯静态服务器无 Netlify Functions
231—
    if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw new ChatError('net');
232—
233—
    const reader = res.body.getReader();
234—
    const dec = new TextDecoder();
235—
    let buf = '';
236—
    let firstDelta = true;
237—
    for (;;) {
238—
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
239—
      if (done) break;
240—
      buf += dec.decode(value, { stream: true });
241—
      const frames = buf.split('\n\n');
242—
      buf = frames.pop(); // 残帧留到下一轮
243—
      for (const f of frames) {
244—
        const line = f.split('\n').find((l) => l.startsWith('data: '));
245—
        if (!line) continue; // 跳过 :ping 注释帧
246—
        let ev;
247—
        try { ev = JSON.parse(line.slice(6)); } catch { continue; }
248—
        if (ev.type === 'tool') { status.textContent = t('chat.searching'); }
249—
        if (ev.type === 'delta') {
250—
          if (firstDelta) { removeThinking(aiEl); firstDelta = false; aiEl.wrap.classList.add('is-streaming'); }
251—
          acc += ev.text || '';
252—
          aiEl.inner.innerHTML = renderMd(acc);
253—
          els.messages.scrollTop = els.messages.scrollHeight;
254—
        }
255—
        if (ev.type === 'error') throw new ChatError(ev.code || 'net');
256—
        if (ev.type === 'done') { /* 正常结束 */ }
257—
      }
258—
    }
259—
    removeThinking(aiEl);
260—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
261—
    if (!acc) throw new ChatError('net');
262—
    maybeSpeak(acc);
263—
    attachReplyActions(aiEl, acc);
264—
    history.push({ role: 'assistant', content: acc });
265—
  } catch (e) {
266—
    removeThinking(aiEl);
267—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
268—
    aiEl.wrap.classList.add('is-error');
269—
    aiEl.inner.textContent = msgForError(e);
270—
    history.pop(); // 失败的 user 消息不污染上下文
271—
  } finally {
272—
    busy = false;
273—
    controller = null;
274—
    setSendState();
275—
  }
276—
}

// ---- 模式 2：本地 BYOK 直连（前端工具循环 + SSE 流式） ----
279—
async function directReply(aiEl, status) {
280—
  const cfg = loadConfig();
281—
  if (!cfg || !cfg.apiKey) {
282—
    removeThinking(aiEl);
283—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
284—
    aiEl.wrap.classList.add('is-error');
285—
    aiEl.inner.textContent = t('chat.settingsNeedConfig');
286—
    history.pop();
287—
    busy = false; setSendState();
288—
    return;
289—
  }
290—
  // Only the localhost BYOK path needs the complete dataset and local tools.
291—
  // Defer that work until the user actually sends a local chat request.
292—
  if (!toolsReady) toolsReady = await initChatTools();
293—
  if (!toolsReady) {
294—
    removeThinking(aiEl);
295—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
296—
    aiEl.wrap.classList.add('is-error');
297—
    aiEl.inner.textContent = t('chat.error');
298—
    history.pop();
299—
    busy = false; setSendState();
300—
    return;
301—
  }
302—
303—
  const provider = getProvider(cfg.provider);
304—
  const baseUrl = provider.baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '');
305—
  controller = new AbortController();
306—
  const lang = window.__lang || 'zh';
307—
  const convo = [{ role: 'system', content: buildSystemPrompt(lang) }, ...history.slice(-8)];
308—
  const FETCH_TIMEOUT = 30000; // 30s 硬超时
309—
310—
  // 通用超时包装：即使 fetch/abort 失效也保证不永久挂起
311—
  const withTimeout = (promise, label) => {
312—
    return Promise.race([
313—
      promise,
314—
      new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new ChatError('timeout')), FETCH_TIMEOUT)),
315—
    ]).catch((e) => {
316—
      // 超时发生时再尝试 abort（忽略失败）
317—
      try { if (controller) controller.abort('timeout'); } catch {}
318—
      console.warn(`[chat] ${label} timeout`);
319—
      throw e;
320—
    });
321—
  };
322—
323—
  const chat = async (body, label) => {
324—
    const res = await withTimeout(fetch(`${baseUrl}/chat/completions`, {
325—
      method: 'POST',
326—
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${cfg.apiKey}` },
327—
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
328—
      signal: controller.signal,
329—
    }), label);
330—
    return res;
331—
  };
332—
333—
  const baseBody = {
334—
    model: cfg.model,
335—
    temperature: 0.3,
336—
    max_tokens: 800,
337—
  };
338—
  // DeepSeek V4 默认开思考模式，本地直连时显式关闭以控延迟（其他家忽略该参数）
339—
  if (provider.id === 'deepseek') baseBody.thinking = { type: 'disabled' };
340—
341—
  let acc = '';
342—
  try {
343—
    let done = false;
344—
    // 工具循环：规划轮非流式
345—
    for (let round = 0; round < MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS && !done; round++) {
346—
      const res = await chat({ ...baseBody, messages: convo, tools: TOOL_SCHEMAS, tool_choice: 'auto', stream: false }, 'plan-' + (round + 1));
347—
      if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) throw new ChatError('auth');
348—
      if (res.status === 429) throw new ChatError('rate');
349—
      if (!res.ok) {
350—
        let detail = '';
351—
        try { detail = (await res.text()).slice(0, 200); } catch { /* ignore */ }
352—
        console.warn('[chat] upstream error', res.status, detail);
353—
        const err = new ChatError('upstream');
354—
        err.detail = detail;
355—
        throw err;
356—
      }
357—
      let data;
358—
      try { data = await res.json(); } catch (parseErr) {
359—
        console.warn('[chat] JSON parse error', parseErr);
360—
        throw new ChatError('net');
361—
      }
362—
      const msg = data.choices && data.choices[0] && data.choices[0].message;
363—
      if (!msg) throw new ChatError('net');
364—
365—
      if (!msg.tool_calls || msg.tool_calls.length === 0) {
366—
        const content = (msg.content || '').trim();
367—
        if (content) {
368—
          acc = content;
369—
          removeThinking(aiEl);
370—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
371—
          aiEl.inner.innerHTML = renderMd(content);
372—
          els.messages.scrollTop = els.messages.scrollHeight;
373—
          done = true;
374—
          break;
375—
        }
376—
        // 内容为空：走流式兜底
377—
        break;
378—
      }
379—
      convo.push(msg);
380—
      for (const call of msg.tool_calls) {
381—
        let args = {};
382—
        try { args = JSON.parse(call.function.arguments || '{}'); } catch { /* keep {} */ }
383—
        status.textContent = t('chat.searching');
384—
        const out = runTool(call.function.name, args);
385—
        let content = JSON.stringify(out);
386—
        if (content.length > 6000) content = content.slice(0, 6000) + ',"_truncated":true';
387—
        convo.push({ role: 'tool', tool_call_id: call.id, name: call.function.name, content });
388—
      }
389—
    }
390—
391—
    if (!done) {
392—
      // 循环用尽仍要工具，或零工具但 content 为空：强制收口流式
393—
      const res = await chat({ ...baseBody, messages: convo, tool_choice: 'none', stream: true }, 'stream');
394—
      if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) throw new ChatError('auth');
395—
      if (res.status === 429) throw new ChatError('rate');
396—
      if (!res.ok || !res.body) throw new ChatError('net');
397—
      const reader = res.body.getReader();
398—
      const dec = new TextDecoder();
399—
      let buf = '';
400—
      let firstDelta = true;
401—
      try {
402—
        for (;;) {
403—
          const { value, done: rd } = await withTimeout(reader.read(), 'stream-read');
404—
          if (rd) { break; }
405—
          buf += dec.decode(value, { stream: true });
406—
          // OpenAI SSE 以 \n\n 分隔事件帧
407—
          const frames = buf.split('\n\n');
408—
          buf = frames.pop() || '';
409—
          for (const frame of frames) {
410—
            const dataLine = frame.split('\n').find((l) => l.startsWith('data:'));
411—
            if (!dataLine) continue;
412—
            const payload = dataLine.slice(5).trim();
413—
            if (payload === '[DONE]') { done = true; break; }
414—
            let ev;
415—
            try { ev = JSON.parse(payload); } catch { continue; }
416—
            const delta = ev.choices && ev.choices[0] && ev.choices[0].delta && ev.choices[0].delta.content;
417—
            if (delta) {
418—
              if (firstDelta) { removeThinking(aiEl); firstDelta = false; aiEl.wrap.classList.add('is-streaming'); }
419—
              acc += delta;
420—
              aiEl.inner.innerHTML = renderMd(acc);
421—
              els.messages.scrollTop = els.messages.scrollHeight;
422—
            }
423—
          }
424—
          if (done) break;
425—
        }
426—
      } catch (streamErr) {
427—
        console.warn('[chat] stream error', streamErr && streamErr.name, streamErr && streamErr.message);
428—
        throw streamErr;
429—
      }
430—
      if (!acc.trim() && firstDelta) throw new ChatError('empty');
431—
    }
432—
433—
    removeThinking(aiEl);
434—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
435—
    if (!acc.trim()) throw new ChatError('net');
436—
    maybeSpeak(acc);
437—
    attachReplyActions(aiEl, acc);
438—
    history.push({ role: 'assistant', content: acc });
439—
  } catch (e) {
440—
    console.warn('[chat] directReply catch', e && e.name, e && e.code, e && e.message);
441—
    removeThinking(aiEl);
442—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
443—
    aiEl.wrap.classList.add('is-error');
444—
    if (e && (e.name === 'AbortError' || e.code === 'timeout')) {
445—
      aiEl.inner.textContent = msgForError(new ChatError('timeout'));
446—
    } else {
447—
      aiEl.inner.textContent = msgForError(e);
448—
    }
449—
    history.pop();
450—
  } finally {
451—
    busy = false;
452—
    controller = null;
453—
    setSendState();
454—
  }
455—
}

// ---- 模式 0：mock（无 Key 纯 UI 调试） ----
458—
async function mockReply(aiEl, status, msg) {
459—
  status.textContent = t('chat.searching');
460—
  await sleep(350);
461—
  removeThinking(aiEl);
462—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.remove('is-streaming');
463—
  aiEl.wrap.classList.add('is-streaming');
464—
  const demo = window.__lang === 'en'
465—

487—
function msgForError(e) {
488—
  if (e && e.code === 'rate') return t('chat.errorRate');
489—
  if (e && e.code === 'auth') return t('chat.errorAuth');
490—
  if (e && e.code === 'timeout') return t('chat.errorTimeout');
491—
  if (e && e.code === 'empty') return t('chat.errorEmpty');
492—
  if (e && e.code === 'upstream') {
493—
    // 上游返回非 2xx：附上简短详情帮助定位（不暴露 Key）
494—
    const d = (e.detail || '').replace(/Bearer sk-[^\s"']+/gi, 'sk-***').slice(0, 120);
495—
    return `${t('chat.errorUpstream')}${d ? ' (' + d + ')' : ''}`;
496—
  }
497—
  if (e && e.code === 'offline') {
498—
    return `${t('chat.errorOffline')} ${location.protocol === 'http:' && !MOCK ? t('chat.errorOfflineHint') : ''}`.trim();
499—
  }
500—
  if (e && e.code === 'no_key') return t('chat.errorNoKey');
501—
  if (e && e.code === 'net') return t('chat.errorNetwork');
502—
  return t('chat.error');
503—
}

function sleep(ms) { return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

507—
// ---------- Markdown 子集渲染（先转义再替换，防 XSS） ----------
508—
function escapeHTML(s) {
509—
  return String(s)
510—
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
511—
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
512—
}
513—
function escapeAttr(s) {
514—
  return escapeHTML(s).replace(/&quot;/g, '&quot;');
515—
}
516—
517—
function renderMd(text) {
518—
  let s = escapeHTML(text);
519—
  const tables = [];
520—
  s = s.replace(/^(\|[^\n]*\|)$/gm, (m) => {
521—
    const id = `@@T${tables.length}@@`;
522—
    tables.push(renderTable(m));
523—
    return id;
524—
  });
525—
  s = s.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<b>$1</b>');
526—
  s = s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
527—
  s = s.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
528—
  tables.forEach((tbl, i) => { s = s.replace(`@@T${i}@@`, tbl); });
529—
  return s;
530—
}
531—
532—
function renderTable(mdTable) {
533—
  const rows = mdTable.trim().split('\n').filter((r) => r.trim().startsWith('|'));
534—
  if (rows.length < 2) return mdTable;
535—
  const parse = (r) => r.trim().replace(/^\||\|$/g, '').split('|').map((c) => c.trim());
536—
  const header = parse(rows[0]);
537—
  const body = rows.slice(1).filter((r) => !/^\|[\s:|-]+\|$/.test(r.trim())).map(parse);
538—
  const html = ['<table><thead><tr>', ...header.map((c) => `<th>${c}</th>`), '</tr></thead><tbody>'];
539—
  for (const r of body) {
540—
    html.push('<tr>', ...r.map((c, i) => `<td>${i === 0 ? '<b>' + c + '</b>' : c}</td>`), '</tr>');
541—
  }
542—
  html.push('</tbody></table>');
543—
  return html.join('');
544—
}

function bindEvents() {
548—
  if (els.toggle) els.toggle.addEventListener('click', toggleChat);
549—
  if (els.fab) els.fab.addEventListener('click', toggleChat);
550—
  if (els.close) els.close.addEventListener('click', closePanel);
551—
  if (els.settingsBtn) els.settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', openSettings);
552—
  if (els.clear) els.clear.addEventListener('click', () => { els.messages.innerHTML = ''; greeted = false; history = []; ensureGreeting(); });
553—
  if (els.form) els.form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); });
554—
  if (els.send) els.send.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
555—
    e.preventDefault();
556—
    if (busy && controller) { controller.abort('user-stop'); busy = false; controller = null; setSendState(); }
557—
    else send(els.input.value);
558—
  });
559—
  if (els.input) els.input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
560—
    if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); send(els.input.value); }
561—
  });
562—
  if (els.chips) els.chips.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
563—
    const btn = e.target.closest('.chat-chip');
564—
    if (btn) send(btn.dataset.q);
565—
  });
566—
  if (els.mic) {
567—
    if (!sttSupported()) els.mic.style.display = 'none';
568—
    else els.mic.addEventListener('click', onMicClick);
569—
  }
570—
571—
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
572—
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && els.panel && els.panel.classList.contains('open')) {
573—
      if (settingsOpen()) { closeSettings(); return; }
574—
      closePanel('escape');
575—
    }
576—
  });
577—
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
578—
    if (!els.panel) return;
579—
    // 请求进行中时不因误点面板外而关闭
580—
    if (busy) return;
581—
    if (els.panel.classList.contains('open') &&
582—
        !els.panel.contains(e.target) &&
583—
        !(els.toggle && els.toggle.contains(e.target)) &&
584—
        !(els.fab && els.fab.contains(e.target))) {
585—
      if (settingsOpen()) { closeSettings(); return; }
586—
      closePanel('outside-click');
587—
    }
588—
  });
589—
}

function maybeSpeak(text) {
594—
  const cfg = loadConfig() || {};
595—

599—
// 给 AI 回复气泡附加操作条：复制全部 / 停止朗读 / 重新朗读
600—
function attachReplyActions(aiEl, mdText) {
601—
  if (!aiEl || !aiEl.wrap) return;
602—
  const plain = (aiEl.inner && aiEl.inner.textContent) || mdText || '';
603—
  const cfg = loadConfig() || {};
604—
605—
  const bar = document.createElement('div');
606—
  bar.className = 'chat-reply-actions';
607—
608—
  // 复制全部回复（优先 clipboard API，非安全上下文回退 execCommand）
609—
  const copyBtn = document.createElement('button');
610—
  copyBtn.type = 'button';
611—
  copyBtn.className = 'chat-reply-action';
612—
  copyBtn.textContent = t('chat.copy');
613—
  copyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
614—
    try {
615—
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(plain);
616—
    } catch {
617—
      const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
618—
      ta.value = plain;
619—
      ta.style.position = 'fixed';
620—
      ta.style.opacity = '0';
621—
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
622—
      ta.select();
623—
      try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch { /* ignore */ }
624—
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
625—
    }
626—
    copyBtn.textContent = t('chat.copied');
627—
    setTimeout(() => { copyBtn.textContent = t('chat.copy'); }, 1500);
628—
  });
629—
  bar.appendChild(copyBtn);
630—
631—
  // 仅当开启了语音播报时才提供停止 / 重播
632—
  if (cfg.voiceOut) {
633—
    const stopBtn = document.createElement('button');
634—
    stopBtn.type = 'button';
635—
    stopBtn.className = 'chat-reply-action';
636—
    stopBtn.textContent = t('chat.ttsStop');
637—
    stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { tts.cancel(); });
638—
    bar.appendChild(stopBtn);
639—
640—
    const replayBtn = document.createElement('button');
641—
    replayBtn.type = 'button';
642—
    replayBtn.className = 'chat-reply-action';
643—
    replayBtn.textContent = t('chat.ttsReplay');
644—
    replayBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
645—
      tts.speak(mdText, { voice: cfg.ttsVoice || null, rate: cfg.ttsRate || 1 });
646—
    });
647—
    bar.appendChild(replayBtn);
648—
  }
649—
650—
  aiEl.wrap.appendChild(bar);
651—
}

653—
// 麦克风点击：正在朗读则先停止；否则开始/停止语音识别
654—
function onMicClick() {
655—
  if (tts.speaking()) { tts.cancel(); return; }
656—
  if (recognizing) { if (stt) stt.stop(); return; }
657—
  stt = createSTT({
658—
    lang: window.__lang || 'zh',
659—
    onInterim: (txt) => { if (els.input) els.input.value = txt; },
660—
    onFinal: (txt) => { if (els.input) els.input.value = txt; send(txt); },
661—
    onState: (s) => {
662—
      recognizing = s;
663—
      if (els.mic) {
664—
        els.mic.classList.toggle('recording', s);
665—
        els.mic.setAttribute('aria-pressed', s ? 'true' : 'false');
666—
        els.mic.title = s ? t('chat.micOn') : t('chat.micOff');
667—
      }
668—
    },
669—
    onError: (e) => {
670—
      recognizing = false;
671—
      if (els.mic) { els.mic.classList.remove('recording'); els.mic.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'); }
672—
      console.warn('[chat] STT error', e && (e.error || e.message || e));
673—
    },
674—
  });
675—
  stt.start();
676—
}

// 测试连接：发一个最小 chat 请求（非流式，max_tokens=1），15s 超时
425—
export async function testConnection(provider, apiKey, model) {
426—
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
427—
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 15000);
428—
  try {
429—
    const res = await fetch(`${provider.baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/chat/completions`, {
430—
      method: 'POST',
431—
      headers: {
432—
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
433—
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
434—
      },
435—
      body: JSON.stringify({
436—
        model,
437—
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'ping' }],
438—
        max_tokens: 1,
439—
        stream: false,
440—
      }),
441—
      signal: ctrl.signal,
442—
    });
443—
    return res.ok;
444—
  } catch (e) {
445—
    return false;
446—
  } finally {
447—
    clearTimeout(timer);
448—
  }
449—
}

function resolveTeam(input) {
113—
  if (!input) return { ok: false, error: 'empty team input', suggestions: [] };
114—
  const q = String(input).trim().toLowerCase();
115—
  if (!q) return { ok: false, error: 'empty team input', suggestions: [] };
116—
  const codeHit = Object.keys(TEAMS).find((c) => c.toLowerCase() === q);

  for (const code of Object.keys(TEAMS)) {

    const t = TEAMS[code];
120—
    if (((t.name && t.name.en) || '').toLowerCase() === q || ((t.name && t.name.zh) || '').toLowerCase() === q) {

125—

  if (args.date_from) out = out.filter((m) => m.date >= args.date_from);

  if (args.date_to) out = out.filter((m) => m.date <= args.date_to);
220—
  out.sort((x, y) => x.id - y.id);
221—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 20), 104);
222—
  return ok({ count: out.length, returned: Math.min(limit, out.length), truncated: out.length > limit, matches: out.slice(0, limit).map(matchBrief) });
223—
}

function tGetStandings(args) {
226—
  if (args.group) {
227—
    const rows = STANDINGS[args.group];
228—
    if (!rows) return fail(`group ${args.group} not found`, { hint: 'A-L' });
229—
    return ok({ group: args.group, standings: rows });
230—
  }
231—
  return ok({ groups: Object.keys(STANDINGS).map((g) => ({ group: g, standings: STANDINGS[g] })) });
232—
}

234—
function tGetBracket(args) {
235—
  const order = ['round_of_32', 'round_of_16', 'quarterfinal', 'semifinal', 'third_place', 'final'];
236—
  const bracketKey = { round_of_32: 'round_of_32', round_of_16: 'round_of_16', quarterfinal: 'quarterfinals', semifinal: 'semifinals', third_place: 'third_place', final: 'final' };
237—
  const project = (n) => ({
238—
    id: n.id, home: n.home, away: n.away, homeName: n.homeName, awayName: n.awayName,
239—
    score: n.score, homeScore: n.homeScore, awayScore: n.awayScore,
240—
    date: n.date, stadium: n.stadium, winner: n.winner,
241—
  });
242—
  if (args.round) {
243—
    const r = normalizeRound(args.round);
244—
    if (!r) return fail(`unknown round ${args.round}`);
245—
    const v = BRACKET[bracketKey[r]];
246—
    if (!v) return fail(`bracket round ${r} not found`);
247—
    const arr = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
248—
    return ok({ round: r, matches: arr.map(project) });
249—
  }
250—
  const all = [];
251—
  for (const r of order) {
252—
    const v = BRACKET[bracketKey[r]];
253—
    const arr = Array.isArray(v) ? v : (v ? [v] : []);
254—
    all.push({ round: r, matches: arr.map(project) });
255—
  }
256—
  return ok({ bracket: all });
257—
}

function tGetAwards() {

    third_place: pick(AWARDS.third_place), fourth_place: pick(AWARDS.fourth_place),

    golden_ball: AWARDS.golden_ball, golden_boot: AWARDS.golden_boot,
265—
    golden_glove: AWARDS.golden_glove, young_player: AWARDS.young_player,

    fair_play: AWARDS.fair_play, tournament_stats: AWARDS.tournament_stats,
267—
  });

function tGetVenueInfo(args) {

  if (args.name) {

287—
    const hit = Object.entries(VENUES).find(([slug, v]) =>
288—
      slug.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (v.name.en || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (v.name.zh || '').includes(q) ||
289—
      (v.city.en || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) || (v.city.zh || '').includes(q));

297—
// ============ B. 射手/助攻 (2) ============
298—
function tGetTopScorers(args) {
299—
  const tally = new Map();
300—
  const byTeam = new Map();
301—
  for (const m of MATCHES) {
302—
    for (const g of m.goals || []) {
303—
      if (g.isOwnGoal || !g.player) continue;
304—
      if (!tally.has(g.player)) tally.set(g.player, { player: g.player, playerZh: playerZhOf(g.player) || g.player, team: g.team, goals: 0, penalties: 0, openPlay: 0 });
305—
      const e = tally.get(g.player);
306—
      e.goals++; if (g.isPenalty) e.penalties++; else e.openPlay++;
307—
      if (!byTeam.has(g.player)) byTeam.set(g.player, g.team);
308—
    }
309—
  }
310—
  let list = [...tally.values()].sort((a, b) => (b.goals - a.goals) || (a.penalties - b.penalties));
311—
  if (args.team) {
312—
    const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
313—
    if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
314—
    list = list.filter((e) => byTeam.get(e.player) === r.code);
315—
  }
316—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 50);
317—
  return ok({ count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
318—
}

320—
function tGetTopAssists(args) {
321—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 10);

  return ok({ note: 'only the official top 10 assists are available in this dataset', top: (AWARDS.top_assists || []).slice(0, limit) });
323—
}

325—
// ============ C. 进球与结果统计 (4) ============
326—
function tTournamentGoalStats(args) {
327—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
328—
  if (pool.length === 0) return fail('no matches for this scope');
329—
  let totalGoals = 0, penalties = 0, ownGoals = 0, cleanSheets = 0, draws = 0;
330—
  let biggest = { margin: -1 };
331—
  const goalsByPeriod = { '1-15': 0, '16-30': 0, '31-45': 0, '46-60': 0, '61-75': 0, '76-90': 0, '90+': 0 };
332—
  for (const m of pool) {
333—
    totalGoals += m.homeScore + m.awayScore;
334—
    if (m.homeScore === 0 || m.awayScore === 0) cleanSheets++;
335—
    if (m.homeScore === m.awayScore) draws++;
336—
    const margin = Math.abs(m.homeScore - m.awayScore);
337—
    if (margin > biggest.margin) biggest = { margin, match: matchBrief(m) };
338—
    for (const g of m.goals || []) {
339—
      if (g.isPenalty) penalties++;
340—
      if (g.isOwnGoal) ownGoals++;
341—
      const t = parseMinute(g.minute);
342—
      if (t <= 15) goalsByPeriod['1-15']++;
343—
      else if (t <= 30) goalsByPeriod['16-30']++;
344—
      else if (t <= 45) goalsByPeriod['31-45']++;
345—
      else if (t <= 60) goalsByPeriod['46-60']++;
346—
      else if (t <= 75) goalsByPeriod['61-75']++;
347—
      else if (t <= 90) goalsByPeriod['76-90']++;
348—
      else goalsByPeriod['90+']++;
349—
    }
350—
  }
351—
  return ok({
352—
    scope: { stage: args.scope || 'all', group: args.group || null, round: args.round ? normalizeRound(args.round) : null },
353—
    matches: pool.length, totalGoals, avgGoals: Math.round((totalGoals / pool.length) * 100) / 100,
354—
    penalties, ownGoals, cleanSheets, draws, biggestMargin: biggest, goalsByPeriod,
355—
  });
356—
}
357—
358—
function tBiggestWins(args) {
359—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
360—
  const list = pool
361—
    .filter((m) => m.homeScore !== m.awayScore)
362—
    .map((m) => ({ ...matchBrief(m), margin: Math.abs(m.homeScore - m.awayScore) }))
363—
    .sort((a, b) => (b.margin - a.margin) || ((b.homeScore + b.awayScore) - (a.homeScore + a.awayScore)));
364—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 5), 20);
365—
  return ok({ count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
366—
}

function tHighestScoringMatches(args) {
369—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);

  const list = pool
371—
    .map((m) => ({ ...matchBrief(m), totalGoals: m.homeScore + m.awayScore }))
372—
    .sort((a, b) => (b.totalGoals - a.totalGoals) || (b.id - a.id));
373—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 5), 20);
374—
  return ok({ count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
375—
}

377—
function tCompareScorers(args) {
378—
  const players = (args.players || []).slice(0, 5);
379—
  if (players.length < 2) return fail('compare at least 2 players', { hint: '{"players":["Mbappé","Messi"]}' });
380—
  const out = [];
381—
  const seen = new Set();
382—
  for (const raw of players) {
383—
    const r = resolvePlayer(raw);
384—
    if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
385—
    const p = r.players[0];
386—
    if (seen.has(p.name)) continue;
387—
    seen.add(p.name);
388—
    const games = [];
389—
    for (const m of MATCHES) {
390—
      for (const g of m.goals || []) {
391—
        if (g.isOwnGoal) continue;
392—
        if (g.player.toLowerCase() === p.name.toLowerCase()) {
393—
          games.push({ matchId: m.id, date: m.date, opponent: g.team === m.home.code ? m.away.code : m.home.code, minute: g.minute, minuteNum: parseMinute(g.minute), isPenalty: g.isPenalty });
394—
        }
395—
      }
396—
    }
397—
    games.sort((a, b) => a.minuteNum - b.minuteNum);
398—
    const goals = games.length;
399—
    const penalties = games.filter((g) => g.isPenalty).length;
400—
    out.push({
401—
      player: p.name, playerZh: p.zh || p.name, team: p.team, goals, penalties, openPlay: goals - penalties,
402—
      matchIds: games.map((g) => g.matchId), minutes: games.map((g) => g.minute),
403—
      firstGoalDate: games.length ? games[0].date : null,
404—
    });
405—
  }
406—
  out.sort((a, b) => b.goals - a.goals || a.penalties - b.penalties);
407—
  return ok({ compared: out });
408—
}

410—
// ============ D. 红黄牌纪律 (3) ============
411—
function tCardRankingsByPlayer(args) {
412—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
413—
  const tally = new Map();
414—
  for (const m of pool) {
415—
    for (const c of m.cards || []) {
416—
      if (!c.player) continue;
417—
      if (!tally.has(c.player)) tally.set(c.player, { player: c.player, playerZh: playerZhOf(c.player) || c.player, team: c.team, yellow: 0, red: 0, total: 0, isStaff: isStaff(c.player), matchIds: [] });
418—
      const e = tally.get(c.player);
419—
      if (c.type === 'red') e.red++; else e.yellow++;
420—
      e.total++;
421—
      if (!e.matchIds.includes(m.id)) e.matchIds.push(m.id);
422—
    }
423—
  }
424—
  let list = [...tally.values()];
425—
  if (args.team) {
426—
    const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
427—
    if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
428—
    list = list.filter((e) => e.team === r.code);
429—
  }
430—
  if (args.type === 'yellow') list = list.filter((e) => e.yellow > 0).sort((a, b) => b.yellow - a.yellow || b.red - a.red);
431—
  else if (args.type === 'red') list = list.filter((e) => e.red > 0).sort((a, b) => b.red - a.red || b.yellow - a.yellow);
432—
  else list.sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total || b.red - a.red);
433—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 50);
434—
  return ok({ note: 'only yellow and red card types exist; entries flagged isStaff are coaching staff', count: list.length, top: list.slice(0, limit) });
435—
}
436—
437—
function tCardRankingsByTeam(args) {
438—
  const pool = filterByScope(MATCHES, args);
439—
  const tally = new Map();
440—
  for (const m of pool) {
441—
    for (const c of m.cards || []) {
442—
      if (!c.team) continue;
443—
      if (!tally.has(c.team)) tally.set(c.team, { team: c.team, yellow: 0, red: 0, total: 0 });
444—
      const e = tally.get(c.team);
445—
      if (c.type === 'red') e.red++; else e.yellow++;
446—
      e.total++;
447—
    }
448—
  }
449—
  const rows = [...tally.values()].map((e) => {
450—
    const played = (BY_TEAM.get(e.team) || []).length;
451—
    return { ...e, matches: played, cardsPerMatch: played ? Math.round((e.total / played) * 100) / 100 : 0 };
452—
  });
453—
  if (args.type === 'yellow') rows.sort((a, b) => b.yellow - a.yellow || b.red - a.red);
454—
  else if (args.type === 'red') rows.sort((a, b) => b.red - a.red || b.yellow - a.yellow);
455—
  else rows.sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total || b.red - a.red);
456—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 48);
457—
  return ok({ count: rows.length, top: rows.slice(0, limit) });
458—
}
459—
460—
function tCardsInMatch(args) {
461—
  let m = null;
462—
  if (args.match_id) m = BY_ID.get(Number(args.match_id)) || null;
463—
  else if (args.team_a && args.team_b) {
464—
    const a = resolveTeam(args.team_a); const b = resolveTeam(args.team_b);
465—
    if (!a.ok) return fail(a.error, a.suggestions);
466—
    if (!b.ok) return fail(b.error, b.suggestions);
467—
    m = MATCHES.find((x) =>
468—
      (x.home.code === a.code && x.away.code === b.code) || (x.home.code === b.code && x.away.code === a.code)) || null;
469—
  }
470—
  if (!m) return fail('match not found', { hint: 'e.g. {"match_id":75}' });
471—
  const cards = (m.cards || []).map((c) => ({ ...c, minuteNum: parseMinute(c.minute), isStaff: isStaff(c.player) }))
472—
    .sort((a, b) => a.minuteNum - b.minuteNum || a.minute.localeCompare(b.minute, undefined, { numeric: true }));
473—
  return ok({ match: matchBrief(m), count: cards.length, cards });
474—
}
475—
476—
// ============ E. 交锋与战绩 (3) ============
477—
function matchWinner(m) {
478—
  if (m.homeScore > m.awayScore) return m.home.code;
479—
  if (m.awayScore > m.homeScore) return m.away.code;
480—
  if (m.penaltyShootout) return m.penaltyShootout.home > m.penaltyShootout.away ? m.home.code : m.away.code;
481—
  return null;
482—
}
483—
484—
function tHeadToHead(args) {
485—
  const a = resolveTeam(args.team_a); const b = resolveTeam(args.team_b);
486—
  if (!a.ok) return fail(a.error, a.suggestions);
487—
  if (!b.ok) return fail(b.error, b.suggestions);
488—
  const meetings = MATCHES.filter((m) =>
489—
    (m.home.code === a.code && m.away.code === b.code) || (m.home.code === b.code && m.away.code === a.code));
490—
  const det = meetings.map((m) => {
491—
    const homeIsA = m.home.code === a.code;
492—
    const winner = matchWinner(m);
493—
    return {
494—
      id: m.id, date: m.date, round: m.round || 'group', stage: m.stage,
495—
      home: m.home.code, away: m.away.code, score: m.score,
496—
      homeScore: m.homeScore, awayScore: m.awayScore,
497—
      winner, viaPenalties: !!m.penaltyShootout,
498—
      aWon: winner === a.code, bWon: winner === b.code, drawn: winner === null,
499—
    };
500—
  });
501—
  let aWins = 0, bWins = 0, draws = 0, aGoals = 0, bGoals = 0;
502—
  for (const d of det) {
503—
    if (d.aWon) aWins++; else if (d.bWon) bWins++; else draws++;
504—
    if (d.home === a.code) { aGoals += d.homeScore; bGoals += d.awayScore; }
505—
    else { aGoals += d.awayScore; bGoals += d.homeScore; }
506—
  }
507—
  return ok({
508—
    teamA: a.code, teamB: b.code,
509—
    played: det.length, aWins, draws, bWins, aGoals, bGoals,
510—
    meetings: det,
511—
    note: det.length === 0 ? 'these two teams did not meet in this tournament' : 'only this tournament\'s matches are included',
512—
  });
513—
}
514—
515—
function tTeamKnockoutRecord(args) {
516—
  const r = resolveTeam(args.team);
517—
  if (!r.ok) return fail(r.error, r.suggestions);
518—
  const code = r.code;
519—
  const kos = MATCHES
520—
    .filter((m) => m.stage === 'knockout' && (m.home.code === code || m.away.code === code));
521—
  const roundOrder = { round_of_32: 1, round_of_16: 2, quarterfinal: 3, semifinal: 4, third_place: 5, final: 6 };
522—
  kos.sort((a, b) => (roundOrder[a.round] || 9) - (roundOrder[b.round] || 9));
523—
  const path = kos.map((m) => {
524—
    const opp = m.home.code === code ? m.away.code : m.home.code;
525—
    const winner = matchWinner(m);
526—
    return {
527—
      round: m.round, opponent: opp, score: m.score,
528—
      homeScore: m.homeScore, awayScore: m.awayScore,
529—
      result: winner === code ? 'W' : (winner === null ? 'D' : 'L'),
530—
      viaPenalties: !!m.penaltyShootout, viaExtraTime: !!m.extraTime,
531—
    };
532—
  });
533—
  const w = path.filter((p) => p.result === 'W').length;
534—
  const d = path.filter((p) => p.result === 'D').length;
535—
  const l = path.filter((p) => p.result === 'L').length;
536—
  const last = kos[kos.length - 1];
537—
  const reached = last ? (last.round === 'final' && matchWinner(last) === code ? 'champion' : last.round) : null;
538—
  const eliminatedBy = (last && matchWinner(last) !== code) ? (last.home.code === code ? last.away.code : last.home.code) : null;
539—
  return ok({ team: code, reached, eliminatedBy, played: kos.length, w, d, l, path });
540—
}
541—
542—
function tCompareGroups(args) {
543—
  let groups = args.groups && args.groups.length ? args.groups : Object.keys(GROUPS);
544—
  const out = [];
545—
  for (const g of groups) {
546—
    const pool = (BY_GROUP.get(g) || []).filter((m) => m.stage === 'group');
547—
    let totalGoals = 0, yellow = 0, red = 0, draws = 0;
548—
    for (const m of pool) {
549—
      totalGoals += m.homeScore + m.awayScore;
550—
      if (m.homeScore === m.awayScore) draws++;
551—
      for (const c of m.cards || []) { if (c.type === 'red') red++; else yellow++; }
552—
    }
553—
    const standing = STANDINGS[g] || [];
554—
    const topTeam = standing.length ? standing[0].code : null;
555—
    const tally = new Map();
556—
    for (const m of pool) {
557—
      for (const goal of m.goals || []) {
558—
        if (goal.isOwnGoal) continue;
559—
        if (!tally.has(goal.player)) tally.set(goal.player, { player: goal.player, playerZh: playerZhOf(goal.player) || goal.player, team: goal.team, goals: 0 });
560—
        tally.get(goal.player).goals++;
561—
      }
562—
    }
563—
    const topScorerInGroup = [...tally.values()].sort((a, b) => b.goals - a.goals)[0] || null;
564—
    out.push({
565—
      group: g, matches: pool.length, totalGoals,
566—
      avgGoals: pool.length ? Math.round((totalGoals / pool.length) * 100) / 100 : 0,
567—
      draws, yellow, red, topTeam, topScorerInGroup,
568—
    });
569—
  }
570—
  return ok({ groups: out });
571—
}
572—
573—
// 20. team_goal_ranking —— 球队进球/失球榜（全赛事或按阶段）
574—
function tTeamGoalRanking(args) {
575—
  const scope = args.scope; // all | group | knockout
576—
  const pool = scope === "group" ? MATCHES.filter((m) => m.stage === "group")
577—
            : scope === "knockout" ? MATCHES.filter((m) => m.stage === "knockout")
578—
            : MATCHES;
579—
  const gf = new Map(), ga = new Map(), played = new Map(), zh = new Map();
580—
  for (const m of pool) {
581—
    const h = m.home.code, a = m.away.code;
582—
    gf.set(h, (gf.get(h) || 0) + m.homeScore);
583—
    ga.set(h, (ga.get(h) || 0) + m.awayScore);
584—
    gf.set(a, (gf.get(a) || 0) + m.awayScore);
585—
    ga.set(a, (ga.get(a) || 0) + m.homeScore);
586—
    played.set(h, (played.get(h) || 0) + 1);
587—
    played.set(a, (played.get(a) || 0) + 1);
588—
    if (m.home.nameZh) zh.set(h, m.home.nameZh);
589—
    if (m.away.nameZh) zh.set(a, m.away.nameZh);
590—
  }
591—
  const rows = Object.keys(TEAMS).map((code) => {
592—
    const t = TEAMS[code];
593—
    const enName = (t.name && t.name.en) ? t.name.en : t.name;
594—
    const zhName = (t.name && t.name.zh) ? t.name.zh : (zh.get(code) || enName);
595—
    return {
596—
      code,
597—
      name: enName,
598—
      nameZh: zhName,
599—
      gf: gf.get(code) || 0,
600—
      ga: ga.get(code) || 0,
601—
      played: played.get(code) || 0,
602—
    };
603—
  });
604—
  const limit = Math.min(Number(args.limit || 10), 48);
605—
  const byFor = rows.slice().sort((x, y) => (y.gf - x.gf) || (x.ga - y.ga) || x.code.localeCompare(y.code));
606—
  const byAgainst = rows.slice().sort((x, y) => (y.ga - x.ga) || (x.gf - y.gf) || x.code.localeCompare(y.code));
607—
  return ok({
608—
    scope: scope || "all",
609—
    topFor: byFor.slice(0, limit),
610—
    topAgainst: byAgainst.slice(0, limit),
611—
    mostFor: byFor[0] ? { code: byFor[0].code, name: byFor[0].name, nameZh: byFor[0].nameZh, gf: byFor[0].gf } : null,
612—
    mostAgainst: byAgainst[0] ? { code: byAgainst[0].code, name: byAgainst[0].name, nameZh: byAgainst[0].nameZh, ga: byAgainst[0].ga } : null,
613—
  });
614—
}

export function runTool(name, args) {
629—
  try {
630—
    const fn = TOOLS[name];
631—
    if (!fn) return fail(`unknown tool: ${name}`);
632—
    return fn(args || {});
633—
  } catch (e) {
634—
    return fail(`tool ${name} failed: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`);
635—
  }

}

// ============ 系统提示词（与 _prompt.mjs 一致） ============
785—
export function buildSystemPrompt(lang) {
786—
  const zh = lang === 'zh';
787—
  return `You are the in-site match analyst for a 2026 FIFA World Cup statistics website.
788—
789—
## Ground rules
790—
1. EVERY factual claim about matches, scores, players, cards, standings, brackets or awards MUST come from a tool call. You have no reliable memory of this tournament - do not answer from prior knowledge, and never guess a score, a minute, a scorer or a number.
791—
2. If the tools return no data, or the data cannot answer the question, say so plainly and state what IS available. Never invent, never extrapolate.
792—
3. If a tool returns { "ok": false } with suggestions, ask the user a short clarifying question using those suggestions.
793—
4. Never mention tool names, JSON, "the dataset", function calling, or your own internals. Speak as a person who knows the tournament.
794—
5. Only 2026 World Cup data exists here. For anything about other tournaments, transfers, live/future matches or player biographies, say it is outside what you can look up.
795—
6. For "which team scored/conceded the most or fewest goals" questions, call team_goal_ranking directly - do NOT try to sum group standings or individual match lists yourself.
796—
797—
## Dataset boundaries - state these limits instead of improvising
798—
- 104 matches: 72 group-stage + 32 knockout. 48 teams in 12 groups (A-L).
799—
- Knockout rounds: Round of 32, Round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place play-off, final.
800—
- Available per match: score, goalscorers with minute, penalty and own-goal flags, yellow/red cards with minute, stadium, referee, attendance, extra time and penalty shootout.
801—
- NOT available: lineups, formations, substitutions, possession, shots, xG, player ages/positions, and any match outside this tournament.
802—
- Cards are only "yellow" or "red" - there is no separate second-yellow record. Some card entries belong to coaching staff; they are flagged as staff - mention it only when it matters.
803—
- Assists data only exists for the official top 10.
804—
- Own goals are credited to the opposing team in the scoreline but are excluded from a player's goal tally.
805—
806—
## Style
807—
- Write like a well-briefed sports broadcaster: confident, concrete, warm. Lead with the answer, then the evidence.
808—
- Keep it under about 180 words unless the user explicitly asks for a full list.
809—
- Use a short markdown table for any ranking or comparison of 3+ rows; plain prose otherwise. No headings, no bullet-point walls.
810—
- Always attach the concrete numbers (score, minute, match id when useful) that back the claim.
811—
- Give exactly one natural follow-up suggestion at the end, only when it is genuinely useful.
812—
813—
## Language
814—
Answer ONLY in ${zh ? 'Simplified Chinese (简体中文)' : 'English'}, regardless of the language the user typed in.
815—
${zh
816—
  ? 'Use the Chinese team names and Chinese player names provided by the tools (fields nameZh / playerZh). If a Chinese name is unavailable, keep the original Latin spelling rather than transliterating it yourself.'
817—
  : 'Use the English team and player names.'}`;
818—
}

// ===== Voice I/O via Web Speech API (pure client-side, no backend) =====
2—

3—
// - TTS: window.speechSynthesis
4—
// Graceful degradation: if a capability is missing, the UI hides the control
5—
// and the helper functions become no-ops.
6—
const SR = (typeof window !== 'undefined') && (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition);
7—
const synth = (typeof window !== 'undefined') && window.speechSynthesis;
8—
9—

10—
export function ttsSupported() { return !!synth; }

12—
// App locale ('zh' | 'en' | ...) -> BCP-47 tag for speech engines.
13—
function langTag(lang) {
14—
  if (lang === 'en') return 'en-US';
15—
  if (lang === 'zh') return 'zh-CN';
16—
  return (lang && String(lang).replace('_', '-')) || 'zh-CN';
17—
}
18—
19—
function clampRate(r) {
20—
  const n = Number(r);
21—
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 1;
22—
  return Math.min(2, Math.max(0.5, n));
23—
}
24—
25—
// Strip markdown so the spoken text is readable (no tables / asterisks / pipes).
26—
function stripForSpeech(s) {
27—
  return String(s)
28—
    .replace(/\|[^\n]*\|/g, ' ')        // table rows
29—
    .replace(/[#*_`>~]/g, ' ')          // common md markers
30—
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
31—
    .trim();
32—
}
33—

// ---- STT ----
35—
// createSTT({ lang, onFinal, onInterim, onState, onError }) -> { start, stop, active }
36—
export function createSTT({ lang = 'zh', onFinal, onInterim, onState, onError } = {}) {
37—
  if (!SR) {
38—
    if (onError) onError(new Error('stt-unsupported'));
39—
    return { start() {}, stop() {}, get active() { return false; } };
40—
  }
41—
  let recognition = null;
42—
  let active = false;
43—
44—
  const stop = () => {
45—
    if (recognition) { try { recognition.stop(); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
46—
    active = false;
47—
    if (onState) onState(false);
48—
  };
49—
50—
  const start = () => {
51—
    if (active) return;
52—
    try { recognition = new SR(); } catch (e) { if (onError) onError(e); return; }
53—
    recognition.lang = langTag(lang);
54—
    recognition.continuous = false;
55—
    recognition.interimResults = true;
56—
    recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;
57—
58—
    recognition.onstart = () => { active = true; if (onState) onState(true); };
59—
    recognition.onend = () => { active = false; if (onState) onState(false); };
60—
    recognition.onerror = (e) => { active = false; if (onState) onState(false); if (onError) onError(e.error || e); };
61—
    recognition.onresult = (ev) => {
62—
      let interim = '';
63—
      let finalText = '';
64—
      for (let i = ev.resultIndex; i < ev.results.length; i++) {
65—
        const res = ev.results[i];
66—
        if (res.isFinal) finalText += res[0].transcript;
67—
        else interim += res[0].transcript;
68—
      }
69—
      if (interim && onInterim) onInterim(interim);
70—
      if (finalText) {
71—
        if (onFinal) onFinal(finalText.trim());
72—
        stop();
73—
      }
74—
    };
75—
    try { recognition.start(); }
76—
    catch (e) { if (onError) onError(e); }
77—
  };
78—
79—
  return { start, stop, get active() { return active; } };
80—
}

// ---- TTS ----

// createTTS() -> { speak(text, opts), cancel(), speaking() }
84—
export function createTTS() {
85—
  let current = null;
86—
  const speak = (text, { voice = null, rate = 1 } = {}) => {
87—
    if (!synth || !text) return;
88—
    cancel();
89—
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(stripForSpeech(text));
90—
    const tag = langTag(window.__lang || 'zh');
91—
    // 朗读语言始终以全站语言（window.__lang）为准，确保与整个应用一致
92—
    u.lang = tag;
93—
    if (voice) {
94—
      const v = synth.getVoices().find((x) => x.name === voice);
95—
      const baseLang = (l) => (l || '').replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 2).toLowerCase();
96—
      // 仅当用户所选音色语言与全站语言一致时才启用，否则跟随全站语言（引擎自动选音色）
97—
      if (v && baseLang(v.lang) === baseLang(tag)) {
98—
        u.voice = v;
99—
        u.lang = v.lang;
100—
      }
101—
    }
102—
    u.rate = clampRate(rate);
103—
    current = u;
104—
    synth.speak(u);
105—
  };
106—
  const cancel = () => {
107—
    if (synth) { try { synth.cancel(); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
108—
    current = null;
109—
  };
110—
  const speaking = () => !!synth && synth.speaking;
111—
  return { speak, cancel, speaking };
112—
}

// Available TTS voices (may be empty until 'voiceschanged' fires).
115—
export function getVoices() {
116—
  if (!synth) return [];
117—
  return synth.getVoices() || [];
118—
}
119—
export function onVoicesChanged(cb) {
120—
  if (!synth) return () => {};
121—
  synth.addEventListener('voiceschanged', cb);
122—
  return () => synth.removeEventListener('voiceschanged', cb);
123—
}

24—

25—

26—

27—
export function resolveSelection(search, allowed) {
28—
  const none = { team: null, opponent: null };
29—

30—
31—

34—

36—

39—

42—
  const pickLastValid = (key) => {
43—
    let found = null;
44—
    for (const raw of params.getAll(key)) {
45—
      const code = String(raw).trim().toUpperCase();
46—
      if (valid.includes(code)) found = code;
47—
    }
48—

49—
  };
50—
51—

52—

54—
55—

56—

export function groupByEdition(matches, code) {
65—
  const list = Array.isArray(matches) ? matches : [];
66—

67—
68—
  for (const match of list) {
69—

70—

71—
    const edition = Number(match.edition);
72—
    if (!Number.isFinite(edition)) continue;
73—
    if (!byEdition.has(edition)) byEdition.set(edition, []);
74—
    byEdition.get(edition).push(match);
75—
  }
76—
77—
  return [...byEdition.entries()]
78—
    .sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0])
79—
    .map(([edition, group]) => ({ edition, matches: group }));
80—
}
81—
