84—
export function listCoverage(coverage, code) {
85—
  const rows = coverage?.[code];
86—
  if (!rows || typeof rows !== 'object') return [];
87—
88—
  return Object.keys(rows)
89—
    .map((key) => Number(key))
90—
    .filter((edition) => Number.isFinite(edition))
91—
    .sort((a, b) => b - a)
92—
    .map((edition) => ({ edition, status: rows[String(edition)] }));
93—
}

// Resolve a stage label from either a match object (with `stage` and optional
111—
// `round` fields) or a plain stage/round string key.
112—
// - When passed a match whose `stage` is 'knockout', the `round` field
113—
//   (e.g. 'round_of_32') is used to look up the label.
114—
// - When passed a string (e.g. 'group', 'round_of_32'), it is looked up directly.
115—
export function stageLabel(match) {
116—
  if (match && typeof match === 'object') {
117—
    const key = match.stage === 'knockout'
118—
      ? (match.round || match.stage)
119—
      : (match.stage || match.round);
120—
    const s = STAGES[key];
121—
    return s ? L(s) : (key != null ? String(key) : '');
122—
  }
123—
  const s = STAGES[match];
124—
  return s ? L(s) : match;
125—
}
126—
127—
// Parse a match minute value into a number for sorting.
128—
// Accepts numbers ("9") and stoppage-time strings like "90+2" (-> 92) or
129—
// "45+3" (-> 48). Unknown values fall back to 0.
130—
function parseMinute(min) {
131—
  if (min == null) return 0;
132—
  if (typeof min === 'number') return min;
133—
  const m = String(min).trim().match(/^(\d+)(?:\s*\+\s*(\d+))?/);
134—
  if (!m) return 0;
135—
  return parseInt(m[1], 10) + (m[2] ? parseInt(m[2], 10) : 0);
136—
}
137—
138—
// Sort events by minute
139—
export function sortEvents(events) {
140—
  return events.slice().sort((a, b) => parseMinute(a.minute) - parseMinute(b.minute));
141—
}
142—
143—
// Calculate standings from matches (fallback if standings.json missing)
144—
export function calcStandings(matches, group) {
145—
  const groupMatches = matches.filter(m => m.stage === 'group' && m.group === group && m.status === 'finished');
146—
  const teams = {};
147—
  groupMatches.forEach(m => {
148—
    [m.home, m.away].forEach(side => {
149—
      if (!teams[side.teamId]) {
150—
        teams[side.teamId] = { teamId: side.teamId, played: 0, win: 0, draw: 0, loss: 0, gf: 0, ga: 0, pts: 0 };
151—
      }
152—
    });
153—
    const h = teams[m.home.teamId], a = teams[m.away.teamId];
154—
    h.played++; a.played++;
155—
    h.gf += m.home.score; h.ga += m.away.score;
156—
    a.gf += m.away.score; a.ga += m.home.score;
157—
    if (m.home.score > m.away.score) { h.win++; h.pts += 3; a.loss++; }
158—
    else if (m.home.score < m.away.score) { a.win++; a.pts += 3; h.loss++; }
159—
    else { h.draw++; a.draw++; h.pts++; a.pts++; }
160—
  });
161—
  const arr = Object.values(teams);
162—
  arr.forEach(t => { t.gd = t.gf - t.ga; });
163—
  arr.sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts || b.gd - a.gd || b.gf - a.gf);
164—
  arr.forEach((t, i) => { t.rank = i + 1; });
165—
  return arr;
166—
}

const R32_ORDER = [73, 76, 75, 78, 84, 83, 82, 81, 74, 77, 79, 80, 87, 86, 85, 88];
10—
const R16_ORDER = [89, 90, 93, 94, 91, 92, 95, 96];
11—
12—
function reorder(matches, order) {
13—
  if (!Array.isArray(matches)) return [];
14—
  return order.map(id => matches.find(m => m.id === id)).filter(Boolean);
15—
}

17—
// Build the set of match IDs on the champion's path through the bracket.
18—
function championPath(bracket) {
19—
  const path = new Set();
20—
  if (!bracket.final || !bracket.final.winner) return path;
21—
  const champ = bracket.final.winner;
22—
  path.add(bracket.final.id);
23—
  const rounds = [bracket.semifinals, bracket.quarterfinals, bracket.round_of_16, bracket.round_of_32];
24—
  for (const r of rounds) {
25—
    if (Array.isArray(r)) {
26—
      for (const m of r) {
27—
        if (m.winner === champ) path.add(m.id);
28—
      }
29—
    }
30—
  }
31—
  return path;
32—
}

export default async function bracketView() {

  if (!bracket || !Object.keys(bracket).length) {
83—
    html += `<div class="loading"><p>${t('common.noData')}</p></div>`;
84—
    html += `</div>`;
85—
    return html;
86—
  }
87—
88—
  const champPath = championPath(bracket);
89—
90—
  // Reorder matches for proper bracket tree structure.
91—
  const r32 = reorder(bracket.round_of_32, R32_ORDER);
92—
  const r16 = reorder(bracket.round_of_16, R16_ORDER);
93—
  const qf = Array.isArray(bracket.quarterfinals) ? bracket.quarterfinals : [];
94—
  const sf = Array.isArray(bracket.semifinals) ? bracket.semifinals : [];
95—
  const final = bracket.final;

  const thirdPlace = bracket.third_place;
97—

  // Round definitions (left to right).

100—

101—

102—
  if (final) finalRoundData.push({ ...final, isThirdPlace: false });

  const rounds = [

  ];

117—
    const isLast = ri === rounds.length - 1;

function renderMatch(match, teamCode) {
